name: gitactionsview
description: GitActionsView - Chronological GitHub Actions run log

scripts.start: npm run build --prefix frontend && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/ && node --env-file=.env backend/src/index.js
scripts.docker: docker build -t gitactionsview . && docker run -d -p 9000:9000 --env-file .env -v ./data:/app/data --name gitactionsview gitactionsview
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
